credit: MaleCNS consortium: FlyEM (HHMI Janelia), University of Cambridge, MRC LMB, Google Research
selection: DNa01/DNa02; top 60 incoming neurons per output; top 3000 incoming neurons from the expanded central/visual/descending shell; top 4500 visual_projection inputs into the first two shells; top 1200 visual_projection nodes by induced outgoing synapse count receive sensors. Classes: ['ascending_neuron', 'cb_efferent', 'cb_intrinsic', 'cb_motor', 'descending_neuron', 'efferent_ascending', 'efferent_descending', 'visual_centrifugal', 'visual_projection']. All induced edges with >=5 synapses; remove nodes without a directed path to an output. Ties by bodyId. Each node includes the official somaLocation [x,y,z] for the 3D atlas.
modelBoundary: Real IDs, annotations, directed edges and integer synapse counts. Reduced subset, not whole brain. Unsigned normalized rate dynamics, sensor injection and evolved motor decoding are artificial, not validated biology. Neurotransmitters and physiology are not simulated.
